text:
Alex (CSM): Heads-up: GreenBridge requested a half-day enablement next Thursday focused on onboarding their analytics + infra teams. They want a tight schedule: 90m hands-on lab for infra, 45m product demo for PMs, 30m office hours. Can we firm up times and owners?

Priya (CS Ops): I can coordinate invites. Which timezone should we target?

Marta (GreenBridge): We're primarily MST with one engineer in CET. Late-morning MST works: Thu 10:00-13:00 MST for the blocks (10:00-11:30 infra lab, 11:45-12:30 PM demo, 12:45-13:15 office hours).

Jules (Trainer): I can lead the infra lab (paired exercises). Draft prereqs: 10m pre-record + short checklist, one sandbox account per pair, and a short survey to capture baseline perf numbers.

Rex (Platform Eng): I'll provision the sandbox and preload dataset "greenbridge-logs-v1" and pin model `gbr-q4-small`. No SSH access; all web containers. ETA Wed EOD. Token creation example: `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/tokens -d '{"user":"gb_pair1"}'`

Alex (CSM): Important: GreenBridge flagged renewal review next month; they want baseline latency + per-token cost captured during the session. Please include a 15m perf dashboard walkthrough.

Jules (Trainer): Adding perf walkthrough (15m) and a 10m KMS/security blurb. Draft agenda: ```
- 10:00 intro + objectives (10m)
- 10:10 infra deep-dive (20m)
- 10:30 paired lab: model pinning + rollout (60m)
- 11:30 perf dashboard & KV cache mini-demo (15m)
- 11:45 PM demo: product flows (45m)
- 12:45 office hours (30m)
```

Priya (CS Ops): I'll send tentative invites now and mark confirmed when sandbox & tokens are ready. Invite subject suggestion: "GreenBridge Enablement: Infra Lab + PM Demo". Recording on.

invite-bot: Event created: "GreenBridge Enablement: Infra Lab" Thu 10:00-11:30 MST guests: 8 (tentative). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/gb-enable

Rex (Platform Eng): Sandbox provisioned. Endpoint: https://sandbox.greenbridge.redwood; token template gb_user_{n}. Temp creds DM'd to Marta.

Marta (GreenBridge): Got creds and shared with the teams. One ask: include a short slide on data anonymization and how we handle PHI-like fields. Compliance is watching.

Jules (Trainer): Will include a 7m segment on anonymization best practises and KMS usage. Also will collect baseline median latency and token cost at the start of the lab.

Alex (CSM): Final checklist before confirming invites:
- Sandbox ready (Rex)
- Prework + short video sent (Jules)
- Attendee list & headcount (Marta)
- Invites + Zoom links (Priya)
- Recording + post-session playbook (Alex)

Priya (CS Ops): Sent tentative invites; will flip to confirmed now that Rex marked infra ready. Any objections? :thumbsup:

Rex (Platform Eng): +1

Jules (Trainer): +1

Alex (CSM): +1

Marta (GreenBridge): +1. Thank you all! Looking forward to Thursday. :raised_hands:
